source_text: ὁ γὰρ θεὸς τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἠγάπησε, δι’ οὓς ἐποίησε τὸν κόσμον, οἷς ὑπέταξε πάντα τὰ ἐν τῇ γῇ, οἷς λόγον ἔδωκεν, οἷς νοῦν, οἷς μόνοις ἄνω πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁρᾶν ἐπέτρεψεν, οὓς ἐκ τῆς ἰδίας εἰκόνος ἔπλασε, πρὸς οὓς ἀπέστειλε τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν μονογενῆ, οἷς τὴν ἐν οὐρανῷ βασιλείαν ἐπηγγείλατο, καὶ δώσει τοῖς ἀγαπήσασιν αὐτόν.
pass_a_gloss: For God loved humans, for whom he made the world, to whom he subjected all on earth, to whom he gave reason and mind, whom alone he allowed to look up to him, whom he formed from his own image, to whom he sent his only-begotten Son, to whom he promised the kingdom in heaven, and he will give it to those who have loved him.
pass_b_english: For God loved human beings — the ones for whom he made the world, to whom he subjected everything on the earth, to whom he gave reason and mind, whom alone he allowed to look upward toward him, whom he formed from his own image, to whom he sent his only-begotten Son, to whom he promised the kingdom in heaven — and he will give it to those who have loved him.

choices.why: Universal human addressees of God’s love and sending.
